function copyNumbers(x: { [n: number]: number } | { [n: number]: string }) {
  const y = { ...x };
  console.log(y[0]);
}
function copyRecord(x: Record<string, number> | Record<string, string>) {
  const y = { ...x };
  console.log(y.foo);
}
function mergeRecords(x: Record<string, number>, z: Record<string, number> | Record<string, string>) {
  const y = { ...x, ...z };
  console.log(y.foo, y.bar);
}
copyNumbers({ 0: 1 });
copyRecord({ foo: 1 });
mergeRecords({ foo: 1 }, { bar: "b" });
